editorialDecl.p: Diplomatic transcription of printed pages 716–745. The page image is authoritative; OCR is corrected against it. Greek verse is encoded as numbered TEI lines. Printed orthography and editorial matter are preserved; machine-generated encoding requires review.

revisionDesc.change: Initial page-level extraction using deepseek-flash; prompt dindorf-aristophanes-fragments-hathi-tei-v3-2026-10-08.

Folded page-local headings into stable Aristophanic work identities, restored Dindorf's per-work numbering, and removed demonstrable duplicate page-724 records; transcribed content otherwise unchanged. Geras is absent from the source extraction.
Split the aggregate fragment corpus into the play-level CTS work tlg0019.poiesis; wording was not changed.

div.note: (1.) Ποίησις in fabulis spuriis ab quibusdam Archippo tributis numeratur ab grammatico supra memorato. div.quote: “Attici πάρα σὲ pro παρὰ σοὶ, quomodo et nos apud te. Aristophanes Ποιηχει (Ποιήσει Brunckius) Γυναῖκα δὲ ζητοῦντες ἕνα δ᾽ οἶκον νυνὶ ἐᾷς ἵνα εἰ παρά σε.”
